messages.text: Sunday dinner at 4 if you're coming. I started the sauce already.
I'll be there. Want me to bring bread from Auddino's?
Yes please, and your father asked if Gina and Luca are coming too.
Texting her now. Save me a corner piece if you made lasagna.
You still coming by Sunday if your cousin has people over Saturday night?
Yeah. I’ll probably head out early anyway if they break out the gummies.
Suit yourself. Just don’t show up half asleep for dinner.
It’s not that. That stuff makes me way too stuck in my own head, so once in a blue moon is enough.
Saw something online saying I should skip that spring shot because "they rushed all of it." You hear anything about that.
I'd go with what Dr. Keller's office says over random posts.
If you want, check MyChart or the Ohio State page. CDC usually has the same guidance spelled out pretty clearly.
Send me the Ohio State one. Easier if it says the same thing as the portal.
Can you look at that portal again when you have a minute? The message about the exercises changed and I don't want to click the wrong thing.
Yep. Forward me the screenshot.
Sent. Also they moved my follow-up to Friday at 10:20.
I can take you. I'll block off the morning and grab groceries after so you don't have to carry bags yet.
You still doing the 8:30 with all seven of yours before forecast?
Yeah. Need to get through Kayla, Ben, Omar, Tiff, Reed, Jenna, and Luis first so I know who’s actually moving.
Grab Priya and Nate after. They usually know which first meetings are real and which are just calendar confetti.
That’s the plan, then pulling Sam in for the Harborview technical piece before I put anything in front of Dana.
Got pulled into the org chart rabbit hole again last night.
Meaning?
Trying to map what gets me from running one team to owning a multi-state number. Feels like I need one more stop in between.
Then make the next stop obvious. Bigger patch, more managers under you, cleaner forecast rhythm.
Yeah. I don't want to be capped at just my current lane forever.
You stepping out at lunch or doing desk salad again
Need to call the eye place first. Realized I should use the yearly allowance before it disappears.
Get the contacts ordered too if they're covered
Yeah and I still need to book the cleaning. I'm trying not to leave all the company stuff untouched till December this time.
You stepping out at lunch or doing desk salad again
Depends if you're about to say something expensive
Need to call the eye place first. Realized I should use the yearly allowance before it disappears.
Get the contacts ordered too if they're covered
Yeah and I still need to book the cleaning. I'm trying not to leave all the company stuff untouched till December this time.
Random but I've been thinking about that ugly one from last fall. You were right that I made the whole floor feel it.
You did. But you also came back the next week and owned it.
I should've said it cleaner then, so: I'm sorry for the way I was with you after it blew up.
Thank you. I know where your head was. The difference now is you don't act like missing one number means you need to get hit twice.
Yeah. Trying to keep the postmortem useful and skip the self-inflicted part.
You coming to the forecast review with the same number from yesterday?
Not unless someone cleans up half the junk sitting in Salesforce first.
lol what broke now
3 deals still in commit with close dates in February, one opp has no next step, and Andre has the same account twice under two spellings.
If we stack a quarter call on top of that, we're basically reading tea leaves.
Fair. I'll ping the team leads before noon.
The new Italian place by the river has a prix fixe on Friday. Are you eating with other humans this week or living on coffee again?
I already told Marcus I'd meet him for dinner Friday, so I can do Sunday instead.
Good. Real plates, not desk snacks.
Sunday around 2 if you want to come by. I'm starting the pot early and making lasagna too.
You say that like I would miss it.
Tell your father that, because he already asked if we really need both.
Yes, we really need both. That's the rule.
Sunday sauce is happening if you want leftovers. I was going to open that bottle your cousin brought at Christmas.
If it's the Chianti, save it for Sunday. Way better with the meat sauce than opened on a random Tuesday.
It is. Come hungry then.
Sunday dinner around 5 if you're free. Anthony wants to try that new bread from Carfagna's and Gina said she'd bring Luca.
I can make 5. Want me to pick up anything on the way?
Just yourself. Mark may come late depending on when he gets out.
I made too much minestrone again. Want to come by tomorrow and take a container?
Yes please. One container is plenty though or I'll be eating soup until Sunday.
Fine, one big one. Easier than you cooking after work every night.
Exactly. My fridge is basically leftovers, mustard, and coffee creamer right now.
If I send you home with the extra stock pot Sunday, do you even have room for it?
Yeah, the lower cabinet next to the sheet pans is still half empty.
Good. Last time I was there the counter was all coffee gear and that little board with wires on it.
I moved the board stuff back to the desk, so the kitchen is usable again.
The museum downtown is open late Friday. They finally put the Impressionist rooms back together.
You always know that stuff before anybody else.
Because I read the listings like a normal person and not a sports page goblin.
lol fair. I still think of those Saturdays when you'd drag us through every floor and then reward us with snacks.
And now you go on purpose.
Sunday I’m making the sauce the way Grandma used to, not the shortcut version.
The long simmer one?
Yes. Your grandfather said his mother would have judged me forever if I rushed it.
Perfect. Save me a container if there’s extra.
For Sunday I'm making braciole. If you stop at the bakery, ask for "un filone di pane" not the seeded one.
Can you text me exactly how to say it lol
I just did. filone di pane. Fee-LOH-neh dee PAH-neh.
Got it. I can do food words. Anything past that and I'm smiling/nodding.
Did you ever put up the museum one from your old place or is it still leaning against the wall?
Finally hung it in the living room last weekend. The other one is still by the bookshelf because I need a second hook.
Good. Things look more finished when they’re actually on the wall.
That soup looked wonderful. Was that your photo with the little rosemary on top?
Yeah, I made it look fancier than it was.
And the museum ceiling from earlier this week too? You always notice the good angles.
That one was mine. I’m saving the hiking one for when the light looks less washed out.
If you do that long weekend in May, pick a place where you can walk around outside all day and still have something good to see after dinner.
Yeah that's exactly what I'm looking for. I don't want just resort/pool time.
You were never built for sitting still anyway. Find somewhere with trails or water in the morning and an old part of town at night.
That sounds pretty ideal honestly.
The museum downtown has that new impressionist exhibit. Made me think of when you used to race to the sketch station before we even got through the first room.
I forgot about the sketch stations. I mostly remember trying to draw statues badly on the backs of the brochures.
Badly? You filled half a kitchen drawer with those. And then came home wanting the soundtrack from every exhibit gift shop.
That tracks. You definitely created that problem.
Your aunt texted asking if we’re doing dinner on the 22nd this year or the Sunday before.
22nd is a Saturday, right? I can do that.
Yes. Hard to believe it’s been 37 years since that long night at Riverside.
You tell that story every year lol
You sounded worn out on the phone. Did you eat dinner yet or just coffee again?
I ate, just late. My shoulders are up by my ears and my stomach's been weird all day.
Then no more laptop tonight. Heat pack and something plain to eat.
Yeah. Hoping if I shut my brain off early I can actually sleep tonight.
Swing by at 6 Sunday if you want. I grabbed that lager your cousin likes.
I’ll come by. Don’t get extra on my account though, I’m good with one beer and then water.
Fine by me. More for everybody else.
You still hearing that radiator knock when the heat kicks on?
Yep. Old building soundtrack.
Tell the landlord before it turns into a bigger mess.
I did. He said he'd send somebody by tomorrow. It's not terrible, just loud in the bedroom wall.
You still thinking about moving when your lease is up?
Maybe later this year, but if I do I'm staying around here.
Why that area specifically?
I can do most stuff without getting in the car. Coffee, a quick dinner, library run, all easy.
And it's simple to get downtown or over toward Short North when I want to meet people.
Did you ever get AEP to stop estimating your electric bill?
Yeah, I called this morning. They fixed it and moved the autopay date so it doesn't hit the same day as rent now.
Good. Better to stagger that stuff.
Exactly. Between rent, gas, electric, internet and groceries the first week gets tight if they all land together.
Mechanic says the front brakes on your mom's car came in higher than expected. You still okay floating the $400 and I'll move it back to you after Friday?
Yeah that's fine. I can send it tonight and I'm not juggling anything else to do it.
Good. Just didn't want you stretching for our headache.
All good. I'd rather just get her car handled.
You still doing your own taxes this weekend or using that online one again
Online again. Mine is pretty straightforward this year. W2, rent stuff, 1099-int and that's basically it.
Straightforward is good. Less hunting for forms.
Exactly. No extra letters or agency paperwork to chase down.
Mortgage calculator says the monthly on that little place off Schrock is still ugly with rates where they are.
Yeah I ran it twice. Between that and condo fees I’m staying put.
Not the worst move. Better than stretching.
Exactly. I can handle something like a $400 car surprise without drama, but I don’t want a payment that gets tight every month if a quarter goes sideways.
Did you ever get those trail shoes or were you still comparing pairs
Got them. More than I planned but the old ones were done.
As long as you wear them for more than one weekend
Trying to. Between those, that framed print I told Mom about, and going out a couple times, last month landed around 5600 all in.
One month won't kill you. Just don't let restaurants become a subscription.
You still coming Sunday around 4:30?
Yep. I can stay a bit after and help with the portal stuff.
Good. Maria wants to send you home with half the lasagna.
Perfect. Makes dinner easy for a couple nights when it's just me.
You still keeping an eye on where the money goes every month?
Trying to. Pulled the card app up today and the run rate was uglier than I thought.
Meaning what
Right around 750 once I added Kroger runs, takeout, coffee, and the two dinners I covered.
That stuff sneaks up. Make coffee at home three days a week and you’ll notice it.
You still thinking about that long coastal drive?
Yeah. Trying to make it a spring thing if work chills out.
Then price it now. Gas, rooms, food, the car. It gets expensive when you wing it.
That’s the plan. I want the whole thing covered ahead of time instead of dragging it behind me for months after.
You still good for pickup Thursday or are you doing old man maintenance now
lol nothing on the calendar except work and me pretending to stretch
So 7 then
Yep. No pharmacy run, no waiting room, no excuses.
You running at Thompson tonight or nah
Yeah. 7 if my knee stops acting 40
Good because today was stupid and I need to sprint at people for an hour
Then come hoop and stop staring at forecast tabs
Already feel attacked
Afterward coffee. You can complain for exactly one medium roast
You still down to hit Thurman Cafe after pickup tomorrow?
I’m gonna skip burgers out for a bit. Trying to keep this month tighter.
Cool. Coffee instead?
Yeah coffee works. Or I can just head home and eat what’s in the fridge.
You doing my place tonight or staying home?
I can head over by 7. I'll grab wings on the way.
Good. They tip at 7:30 and I am not watching that last stretch alone again.
lol fair. If Garland starts cooking I'm taking credit for the buffalo sauce.
You putting the game on Friday or we doing a bar?
Come by my place. I'll grab wings and a couple people can post up here.
Better. I can bring beer.
Do that. Tip is around 7 and I'm cleaning the living room tonight so nobody roasts me.
Running 10 late. Got lit up on 315 for rolling a little too fast.
You getting a ticket or just the lecture
Just a warning. Registration was in the glove box graveyard so that was cool.
😂 clean your car and come get buckets
You still coming by for coffee or you cooked?
Rain check. Had my monthly sit-down on video and my brain's kind of done for today.
Got it. Then no extra plans. Eat something and go horizontal.
You still coming to pickup Sunday or are you doing that drink with Hannah's friend?
Still planning on ball. Drink got moved to Friday.
Different person from the app one or same one
Different. App one was fine, just not enough there for a round 2.
Efficient king
You still good for coffee after pickup Sunday?
Yeah. And thanks again for what you told me after the game last week.
About the stop stuff?
Yeah. I keep replaying the part where your dad taught you exactly where to put your hands. That hit me.
Wild what becomes normal when you grow up with it.
I know. I never had to think about any of that on a routine drive.
That city council clip was a mess. Whole room arguing in circles.
It shouldn't be that hard to at least publish clean numbers on stops and force incidents.
Yep. Everybody says "trust us" and then there's nothing to look at.
Exactly. And if something goes sideways, it can't just stay inside the same building. Needs somebody outside it reviewing it.
You still good for coffee after runs Sunday?
Yeah. Also been thinking about what you said after ball last week.
About getting lit up for a busted taillight like it was a felony? lol yeah
Not lol, really. I've had cops wave me through stuff or keep it super casual. I always treated that like the normal setting.
For you maybe.
Exactly. Took me too long to clock that.
That city council clip was a mess. Whole room arguing in circles.
It shouldn't be that hard to at least publish clean numbers on stops and force incidents.
Yep. Everybody says "trust us" and then there's nothing to look at.
Exactly. And if something goes sideways, it can't just stay inside the same building. Needs somebody outside it reviewing it.
You around tonight
yeah what's up
Need to get out of my own head for a minute. Coffee or a quick run at the gym?
gym. 9:15 at the Y. we'll shoot and you can stop staring at your phone
Perfect. Thanks.
still at my laptop fixing numbers for tomorrow and somehow I've already demolished half a bag of kettle chips
close the spreadsheet for 20 and eat something that came from a plate
I had pasta at like 6. this is just me pacing between tabs and grabbing salty stuff
then step away before it turns into chips + inbox + midnight
You make it out alive after last night or are your legs filing complaints
Whole body is annoyed. Worth it though. Good run.
Same crew Sunday too. 9 at the church gym if enough guys reply.
I'm in unless weather flips and I head north with the trail people.
You alive after last night or what
Barely. Almost talked myself out of going at 5:45.
Good thing you didn't. We would've been running 4s and Trevor would've complained the whole time.
Honestly knowing you guys were counting bodies is the only reason I put my shoes on.
Still wild to me that you've been doing one-on-ones and forecast cleanup for this long.
A little over two years of it and I still have reps who can smell hesitation through Slack.
Yeah but year one you would've rewritten their emails yourself. Progress.
True. Now I just leave comments and make them suffer constructively.
How'd your morning appointment go.
Fine. Just the usual once-a-year stuff and a lab slip.
Anything expensive?
Not really. Office visit was a copay and I moved money from the HSA for the bloodwork if it posts separately.
Good. Better to get it done than let it sit.
Sunday sauce at 5 if you want leftovers too.
I can come after the thing I do Tuesday nights, but probably closer to 7.
That works. I'll save you a plate so you don't rush over hungry.
I found the old Palm Sunday booklet in the hall drawer. The one with your grandmother's handwriting all over the margins.
Keep that one. I can still hear everybody trying to come in together on the first verse and Grandma being half a beat ahead.
She sang like she was trying to hold the whole pew up by herself.
Honestly one of the few sounds that still lands right away for me. That and the bells.
You still good for tonight at Thompson? We need one more if Nate flakes again.
Yep. Leaving work a little early so I can get there by 6:30.
Good. I am not guarding those college kids by myself.
I'm already planning to pretend I can still run for two hours.
You still coming Sunday or are you dodging my crossover again
I'll be there. Also if DeShawn's cousin comes, tell him I wasn't trying to talk over him last time.
You're fine. Just don't do the "my grandpa came from Naples so basically same thing" move again lol
Yeah fair. That sounded dumber out loud than it did in my head.
Just be normal and play defense for once
You on already? It's barely light out.
Just got back. Quick half hour before calls start stacking.
Look at you being responsible.
Trying to get two short ones in during the week or I turn into a chair.
You still putting in for Friday the 21st or did quarter-end eat that too?
Still taking it. I barely used any days last year besides the week at Christmas and those two sick days in October.
Good. Use the days before they just become spreadsheet trivia.
You staying on for the comp deck tomorrow or are you making Dan walk through it
I should stay. Half my team still thinks accelerators are magic.
lol fair. also check the line on manager payout. finance changed the threshold again
Saw that. Better than last year at least.
You still in the laptop cave or did you finally stop staring at forecast?
I shut it. Brain is cooked.
Good. Leave it shut for one night.
That is the plan. Reheating pasta and putting on something dumb for an hour.
Correct choice.
You still online or did you finally shut the laptop?
Shut it. Going analog for a bit so I don't keep replaying that call.
Good. No more forecast spirals tonight.
Plan is one mug of tea, a few pages, then bed.
Random question: if I park extra cash in a separate savings bucket, do you leave it at a different bank so it takes a day or two to move back?
That’s the whole point. Harder to raid when you get a bright idea at 10 pm.
Exactly. If a cheap Lisbon fare pops up after dinner I become a different person.
Then make the transfer automatic and stop browsing. Future you will be less annoyed.
Setting it up tonight.
I made too much sauce again. Want me to send some home Sunday?
I’m good for this week, still working through the pot I made Monday.
Look at you. Did you do your usual chicken and vegetables too or just noodles
Chicken, broccoli, and farro. Kept some sauce separate so it doesn’t turn into glue by Thursday.
You still here or did you finally escape?
Still at my desk. Two reps needed help with pricing and I still have tomorrow's call notes to clean up.
I saw your coat still hanging up. You were here Tuesday too, right?
Yeah. Tues, today, and probably Monday next week. Rest I'm doing from home unless something catches fire.
Go home after notes. The spreadsheet will still be obnoxious tomorrow.
You up early again? I sent the pricing doc but no need to look right this second.
Just wrapping my lap around the block. No headphones rule this morning.
Probably smarter than doom-refreshing Salesforce at 8am.
Trying that plus not opening Slack before coffee helps.
If you're trying to get away in April, put it in now. Once kickoff starts everybody suddenly remembers they have plans.
Yeah I was looking this morning. I already burned most of mine between the lake week, the October days, and those random long weekends.
Then grab whatever's left before the vultures do.
Did you end up going last night or did work ruin it?
I went. Stayed longer than I meant to.
Good. You always come home lighter after looking at things and wandering around.
There were a couple pieces made from layered plastic and light that were great. I sent myself two names to look up later.
Run at the church gym Sunday?
I’m out for this one. Still not pushing hard on that left foot yet.
Still from that roll-up under the hoop?
Yeah. It’s way better than it was, just trying not to be dumb and restart the clock.
Fair. Coffee after then.
You still thinking about that long coastal drive?
Yeah. Trying to make it a spring thing if work chills out.
Then price it now. Gas, rooms, food, the car. It gets expensive when you wing it.
That’s the plan. I want the whole thing covered ahead of time instead of dragging it behind me for months after.
You vanished kinda early last night lol
Yeah once the room got quiet and everyone was on the couch I was done
The tiny candy got you?
Barely any, but even that is enough for me. I start overthinking dumb stuff and would rather just have one beer next time.
You still replaying that demo in your head or did you finally put the laptop down
Rudely specific. Coffee helped a little.
Good. Stop trying to rewrite Thursday. We both saw the client go sideways before pricing even came up.
Yeah. I know. Thanks for the reality check.
Any time. Take a real morning and don't open Salesforce until at least noon.
If you're coming Sunday, bring that black frame you were asking Dad about. I still think the print by the bookshelf would look better matted.
I grabbed the 16x20 last night. Going to swap the thin one out before I come over.
Good. The lighter mat made it look crowded.
Can you be on uncle duty for like 45 minutes Wednesday? Mark has a dentist thing and I need to finish a call before preschool pickup.
Yep. I can swing by after work. What does Luca want, books or soccer ball?
If you bring both he'll campaign to keep you forever.
Are you still coming for sauce later or are you out on the trails again this morning?
Still going if the drizzle clears. We pushed the start back 30 minutes to see what the sky does.
Okay. Just don't show up soaked and starving at 4.
No promises on the starving part.
Found your lease spreadsheet. You still compare things like you're pricing branch inventory.
Learned from the guy who used to track pallets, routes, and margins for half of central Ohio.
It kept the lights on. Different world now.
True. Mom still marked up every paper I wrote like I was in third grade, so between the two of you I never had a chance.
She was usually right.
Neighbor’s kid asked if you had some extra letters after your name and wanted advice on programs. I told him ask you about sales instead.
lol good call. I stopped at the regular four-year one.
Still counts. He mainly needs somebody to tell him not to borrow a fortune without a plan.
That part I can definitely help with.
Hey, was I weirdly quiet after that team lunch Friday?
A little. You looked like you were actually listening for once lol
Jamal talking about getting pulled over three times in one year stayed with me.
Yeah. A lot of people hear stories like that and move on by Monday.
I haven't really moved on. Between that and stuff Marcus told me, it's been sitting in my head.
Running behind and Luca melted down after soccer. We're just doing grilled cheese here tonight instead of coming over there.
All good. Tell him uncle still has the volcano kit whenever he's back in civilization.
lol. You doing anything?
Not really. Was half counting on the usual Sunday noise.
You can come here if you want but fair warning it's shin guards, cartoons, and me ignoring laundry.
Appreciate it. I may just order takeout and watch the game.
Mom wants a head count for Sunday because she’s doing the big pan again.
I’m in. Just me.
Ok. She said if you come early you can help roll everything before everybody piles in.
That works. After last weekend I’m pacing myself when the cousins start doing the rounds.
Got that piece home from Uptown Frame. Looks good over the record shelf but I’m not trusting the cheap hardware that came with it.
Use a real anchor if it’s got any weight to it. Don’t hang it with the junk they throw in the bag.
Yeah I’m running to Ace tomorrow. Not trying to hear glass hit the floor at 2 a.m.
You were a little sharp with Evan on that forecast call
I know. I backed off after.
Did you get your usual Sunday reset this week
Nope. No ball, no walk. Whole week started sideways.
Thought so. Go disappear for 30 tonight before you answer anybody else.
You in for coffee or are you doing your spreadsheet monk routine again
Spreadsheet monk. Two drafts hit this week and I wanted to make sure everything landed where it should.
Month-start joys
Yep. Car one already cleared and the federal one is tomorrow, so I'm keeping the rest of the weekend quiet.
You hopping on the forecast cleanup tonight?
Can do after 8:45. I've got my usual Wednesday run at the rec first.
Fine, but if you come back and start heroic spreadsheeting, I'm muting you.
Fair. I'll send the notes after I shower and stop limping around.
You went quiet after work. You good?
Long day. Can I call you after Luca's down?
Yep. 8:45 is fine. I'll pick up.
Calling now
Parent group is doing the usual thing again and now half of them are passing around screenshots from some wellness account.
Yeah I'd skip screenshot medicine.
Luca's pediatrician or Nationwide/Ohio State pages are going to be a lot more useful than somebody's reel with dramatic music.
That's basically where I landed. Real people with names and a hospital logo, not influencer University.
Luca says your vacation should have "mountains and old buildings" so apparently he's helping now.
Kid gets me.
Better than your usual habit of making a spreadsheet for three cities and then rejecting the one with the prettiest views because there's nothing to do after 5.
To be fair I also don't want the opposite where it's all galleries and I never get outside.
You doing the Florida thing with Marcus or still undecided?
Still want to go, just keeping it cheap if I do.
Carry-on cheap or ramen cheap?
Carry-on cheap. I’m not draining the other two piles for a beach weekend.
Look at you being responsible and mildly boring.
Luca says you smell better than Uncle Rob because you don't come in smelling like a bonfire lol
High praise. Tell him that is because I am not trying to marinate in patio air.
He also wants to know if you’re bringing the fancy bread again Sunday.
Yes, and probably a bottle of red for dinner.
Can I send Luca over Saturday for a couple hours if Mike gets stuck at work?
Yeah, that's fine. Just know my place is tiny so bring the quiet stuff, not the giant fort kit.
lol noted. Books and the small Lego box.
Perfect. He can spread out in the living room but that's basically the whole operation over here.
Luca found that old photo of you in the living room holding a tiny keyboard and looking extremely serious about it
Was that from the phase where Mom kept bringing home tapes and I acted like I was starting a one-man band
Yes lol. Also there are crayon drawings all over the coffee table in the same batch. Very on brand from age 7.
Honestly sounds like a pretty solid use of a childhood.
You hooping Sunday or buried again?
Should be there. Just trying to get everyone lined up for quarter push.
Everyone = how many people this week
Seven closers, plus I’m in the weeds with two top-of-funnel people and our demo guy because three deals all need different stuff at once.
That’s a lot of cats. Come get your runs in anyway.
Panel go alright?
Yeah. Weird hearing myself say it out loud, but that internship basically did it.
The one where you kept tagging along to those customer meetings?
Yep. I realized I didn't want to build the system. I wanted to be in the room explaining why it mattered once real people were on the other end.
You still on for Sunday ball or is quarter-end eating your life again
I'm in. Might be late if I have to finish numbers first.
Didn't you just hit some work milestone too
Yeah, four years there this month. Feels weird because the first half was me trying to figure out the place and now I'm the guy calming everyone down.
Old head status.
You still on for coffee tomorrow or did you buy yourself a one-way ticket somewhere again
Coffee. I made myself wait 48 hours before booking anything this month.
Growth.
Had a whole 'just go, who knows' speech ready in my head, so I transferred money out of checking instead.
Good. Let Spreadsheet John save Vacation John from himself.
Spring game time posted yet or still waiting
Still waiting on the official time I think. If it's midafternoon I can come over early and help with the Roku before everybody starts yelling.
Do that. Last year your mother changed the input and we missed the first series.
Putting it on my list now. I'll text Gina too in case they want to stop by.
Saying no to dinner out tonight. I did the numbers and I need this month to stay boring.
Quarter-end boring or wallet boring?
Wallet. When I keep it normal I'm usually somewhere in the high 4s for the month already.
Then skip the steak and protect the spreadsheet.
You still doing the thing at the museum tonight or did quarter-end eat your plans
Still going. It's the visiting show everyone kept posting about and I already bought the ticket.
Good. Go look at objects on walls instead of Salesforce for one evening.
You hopping on forecast at 9:30 or still stuck at the lab place?
At Riverside now. They could fit me in this morning so I figured I'd knock it out.
Good call. Send me whatever changed in the sheet after.
Will do. Should be out by 9:40 unless they run behind.
You skipping team lunch again?
Yeah, brought leftovers. Trying to stop leaking money on random stuff for a bit.
Quarter-end monk mode?
More like I want that Highway 1 week to exist in real life.
Fair. Leftovers are cheaper than airport sandwiches and motel panic.
You still in for the Short North thing tonight or did quarter-end eat your personality again?
Still going. I need to look at paintings and be around people who aren't arguing over pipeline math.
Excellent. And Saturday?
Museum in the afternoon, then that beginner scene-work workshop at 6 if I don't chicken out.
Go. Worst case you commit too hard to pretending you're buying bananas.
You hopping on that town hall stream or are you protecting your blood pressure tonight
Half watching. I wanted to hear the part on storm-grid upgrades and the bill about warehouse scheduling rules.
Very on brand for you.
I just want grown-ups in charge and fewer situations where regular people get crushed because nobody planned anything.
A platform of competence and less nonsense. Stunning.
Did the bigger commission finally hit or are they still doing finance acrobatics?
Hit this afternoon. I already split it before I could talk myself into dumb purchases.
Lol what was the split
$700 over to the cash cushion, $500 into index funds, and I bumped payroll a little too. Lands me around 1,700 for the month all-in.
You are aggressively boring and I mean that as a compliment.
You survive the week?
Barely. Saturday is fine. Tomorrow night is the part I never love.
Because Monday or because everyone starts posting matching brunch photos with toddlers?
A little column A, a lot of column B.
Then make a plan before 6. Gym, movie, call Marcus, whatever. Don't just let the apartment get too quiet.
Yeah that's probably smarter than scrolling through everybody's minivan era.

Late like your usual late, or the kind where you forget dinner and answer emails at 10?

Then I'm sending you home with lasagna whether you stay an hour or five minutes.

Already put it on the charger in the kitchen.

You still going over that notebook every night?

On your own how?
Small shop, not giant firm energy. Help teams fix pipeline discipline, hiring, deal reviews. More hands-on.

Send me both pages. I can compare them with the portal and the insurance claim.

Text me the morning readings and I'll upload everything tonight. I can call if the cholesterol paperwork is still hanging out there.
Still thinking about that place near Henderson? Rates are ugly but at least you answer to nobody on paint colors.

Yeah. I like coming back to it after a long day.
You still get overtime for all those late quarter-end nights or no

Want me to add your usual from that Italian place Friday when we order?
I’m good. Doing a boring stretch after the card bill.
Copy. Come raid mom and dad’s leftovers Sunday then.

Helpful as always
Zin works. Or a big California cab. If they have Barolo and it's not absurd, that too.

Please no production. It's just me.
Also how was coffee with the museum person

That is the least surprising sentence you've ever sent
Are you coming Sunday or doing one of your wander-through-the-woods days again
Morning only. Meeting the group at Highbanks at 10, then I'll come by after.
Cool. Luca wants you there before dessert this time.

then don't make the apartment your little snack bar tonight

tiny robot table always wins eventually

you shutting the whole thing down or just ignoring the committee
not shutting anything down. I'm just not going to manufacture a whole life because relatives want a cleaner schedule
